pages.text: Create: Power Loader keeps chunks loaded so machines keep working when you are away. The cost is rotation: a spinning shaft keeps the chunk awake.

pages.title: Empty loaders
pages.text: Empty loaders come dead. Right-click a Ghast with one to capture it. Once powered, the ghasts light the portal cores.

pages.title: Andesite Chunk Loader
pages.text: Loads its own chunk while spun fast enough. Slower rotation means it fails. It gives a comparator signal while active.

pages.title: Brass Chunk Loader
pages.text: Loads 1x1, 3x3 or 5x5 chunks. Bigger areas need faster rotation. Set the range on the value panel.

Brass loaders work on moving contraptions (always 3x3, no rotation needed once assembled) and on Train Stations. At a station the area is loaded only while a train is there. See $(l:transport/trains)Trains$(/l) and $(l:create_basics/contraptions)Contraptions$(/l).
When power is lost there is a short, configurable delay before unloading, so brief stalls are fine. Loaded chunks still tick machines, so a big loader grid costs performance.
